name: GKW Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1931, GKW Ltd is in the business of Warehousing, and Investment and Treasury[1]
keyPoints:
Services Offered:
a) Warehousing:[1]
GKWL provides integrated warehousing and logistics solutions in Kolkata and owns a significant land bank at Andul, Howrah—one of the largest on-demand warehousing sites near the city’s administrative hub. Additionally, the company holds a 37-acre land parcel in Bhandup, Mumbai, earmarked for mixed-use development.
